_what: The closest common course (M-ID) for each local course that needs one, with a measured confidence, and the exhibit links each recommended M-ID carries (links). Built by kb/_closest_mid.py from committed files, daily when an input changed (fingerprint); display only. A person curates from the course's panel.

measure.how: Each sampled course is taken out of its own common course, then ranked. Right means the first recommendation is its own M-ID. A course that was its common course's only local course counts wrong whatever is recommended (only_course).

row_shape: control number: [confidence, band, [[M-ID, score, courses with the same title, the common course's local courses, catalog overlap or null], up to three]]; links: M-ID: exhibit links
links_what: Exhibit links per recommended M-ID: the records in kb/coci_articulations.json whose course_id, resolved through kb/alias_chain.py, is the M-ID. Only M-IDs some row recommends, and only those with a link; an M-ID absent here has none. The Courses List sorts the pile by the links of each row's first recommendation at a strong or possible match.
